verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs show event-driven automation: emails send automatically when new blog or RSS content is published, and users can set up simple workflows to automate actions after an email is sent. The evidence is thin, though. It describes only 'simple' workflows tied to email sends and never documents how rules are defined, what conditions or branching exist, or which trigger events are available. Missing for 10: documented rule/condition definition, a range of trigger event types and action types, multi-step or branching workflow logic, API or programmatic workflow configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can set up simple workflows to automate actions after the email is sent.
